tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: Lists the sections of Testy elektryka (Polish electrician course and ELE.02 question bank): name, number of lessons and questions, link to the questions page and the first lesson. Use it first to pick a section.

tools.name: list_exams
tools.description: Describes the ELE.02 mock exam on Testy elektryka (format, pool size, link) and the guides to SEP G1 certificates, the journeyman (czeladnik) and master (mistrz) exams. Optional filter by exam name.

tools.name: find_lessons
tools.description: Finds lessons of the free course "Elektryk od zera" and guides on Testy elektryka by a phrase in the title (Polish, diacritics optional) and/or section. Returns at most 10 results (title, section, link). Lessons are read on the website.

tools.name: practice_questions
tools.description: Returns up to 5 random multiple-choice questions from a small sample set of Testy elektryka (ELE.02 style), optionally filtered by section, each with the correct answer, a short explanation in Polish, its source and a link to the question page.
